evidence: Phase 0 fixtures plus Phase 2 settings, Phase 3 typed events, Phase 4 search and links, Phase 5 native ABI and UI verification, Phase 6 bounded native rewind, Phase 7 persistent multi-rule highlights, Phase 8 exact native snapshots, and Phase 9 live history resizing

capabilities.capability: Unicode, wide, combining, and emoji glyphs

capabilities.note: Persistent multi-rule highlights render in Atlas with selection and search precedence, exporting compact overview rows for the ruler without mutating TextAttribute cells.

capabilities.capability: plain, HTML, and RTF selection copy

capabilities.note: ABI 3.1 resizes TerminalCore history in place, retaining newest rows, viewport and cursor state, links and marks, and rebuilt search and highlight indexes.
ABI 3 exact native keyframes use the 10-second or 1-MiB capture policy and the shared 30-minute or 32-MiB bounds.

Architecture-independent, checksummed, bounded TLV snapshots restore both buffers, cell metadata, cursor and viewport state, parser state, terminal modes, marks, links, colors, character sets, saved cursors, title, and working directory before renderer attachment.
Read-only native playback builds periodic exact seek keyframes once and restores the nearest frame before replaying later output and resize events.

capabilities.capability: input, focus, resize, DPI, split visibility, and teardown
